text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. TWO Recommendation Letters One is from the principal of high school and one is from the teacher. Applicants with high education should provide 2 recommendation letters from professor or associate professor in the graduated university or college. Original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation. * 2. Study Plan An undergraduate study plan, including applicants' understanding of the discipline or major they are applying for and their plan, about 400 words. * 3. Certification of Bank Deposit * 4. A scanned copy of passport valid for more than 6 months. * 5. Single person color photo without a hat, taken recently within the last 6 months (same size as the one on the passport). * 6. High School Graduation Certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 7. High School transcript Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Certificate of HSK No need for Chinese Language and Literature major. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. - Mathematics is required (Examination language is Chinese) . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
